title: Most people have never seen a railway hump yard in action — so I made one playable
author: InterestingSir6557
selftext:
A freight train is pushed uphill. A worker uncouples the cars. Then gravity takes over, sending them rolling downhill onto different tracks.

It sounds simple until you have to decide where to uncouple, when to tell the driver to slow down, and how to coordinate with the locomotive crew.

I built a 3D browser game where you can try the job yourself — solo or with a friend. One player works as the yard conductor, while the other drives the locomotive.

It's based on my experience working at a real hump yard in Uzbekistan.

🎮 Play in your browser: [https://gorka1520.vercel.app?lang=en](https://gorka1520.vercel.app?lang=en)
